Oh, no, it’s everywhere, doc. Not just at work. Like I was saying, if somebody just comes up behind me—doesn't matter where I am—I jump right out of my skin. And then my heart just keeps hammering and hammering for way too long.

But anyway, I'm standing there trying to find the sausages, and this older lady just reaches past my shoulder to grab a pack of bacon. Came up right behind me without making a sound. Man, I practically jumped into the freezer case. My chest was just pounding away for a good ten minutes while she just stared at me like I was a lunatic. Well, doc, like I was just saying... I'm not really sure about the quiet times. I don't really sit around much. I mean, maybe? But mostly I just try to keep moving.
